recentItems.title: Germany’s far right set for historic win, short of majority
recentItems.description: Germany’s far-right AfD is on course for a historic victory in Saxony-Anhalt, a result that could put it closer than ever to leading a state government, though rival parties have ruled out cooperation and could block it from taking power. The win delivered the AfD 39 of 83 seats in parliament, just short of the 42 it needed for an absolute majority.

recentItems.title: Witkoff and Kushner wrap weekend of diplomacy with Russia, Ukraine
recentItems.description: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, President Donald Trump’s son-in-law, pushed for a return to trilateral talks between the US, Russia and Ukraine on Sunday after “substantive” discussions with Ukrainian officials in Kyiv. The talks followed intensive meetings Witkoff and Kushner held with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow on Saturday, part of Washington’s renewed push to end the war in Ukraine. CNN’s Julia Benbrook reports.

recentItems.title: Hydropower workers on how they survived Nepal’s floods
recentItems.description: CNN’s Hanako Montgomery shares tearful stories she heard from the hydropower plant workers who survived the deadly Nepal floods.

recentItems.title: Teen battling brain cancer gets surprise from Florida Gators
recentItems.description: A Georgia teenager battling a rare and aggressive form of pediatric brain cancer gets a surprise of a lifetime. CNN’s Patrick Snell talks to the teen and his family.

recentItems.title: US sinks 3 Iranian tankers in Strait of Hormuz escalation
recentItems.description:
The United States military said Saturday its forces struck three Iranian crude oil carriers after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) launched ballistic missiles toward two US Navy warships.

The fresh exchanges threaten to heighten a shipping war in and beyond the Persian Gulf, as Iran seeks to prevent shipping transiting the Strait of Hormuz without its consent and the US steps up targeting of Iranian shipping.

recentItems.title: Driverless cars compete in F1-style race
recentItems.description: Fully autonomous cars competed in the first international edition of the Abu Dhabi Autonomous Racing League in Imola, Italy, on Saturday. The cars have no human drivers and are instead driven completely by AI. CNN’s Ivana Scatola was there to watch the action.

recentItems.title: 5 dead after Amazon plane overruns runway in Miami
recentItems.description:
At least five people are dead after an Amazon cargo aircraft overran the runway during a landing at Miami International Airport on Sunday afternoon, striking multiple vehicles on a road surrounding the airport, officials said.

There is no apparent threat to public safety at this time, the Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office said during a news conference Sunday evening. The scene is still active.
